old_caption: The video depicts a serene nighttime scene on a quiet street lined with old-fashioned buildings. The focal point is a series of illuminated street lamps casting a warm, yellow glow that contrasts sharply with the dark blue sky. The lamps are evenly spaced along the street, creating a rhythmic pattern of light and shadow. The buildings, painted in muted tones of white and beige, feature traditional architectural details such as shutters and decorative elements. The street itself appears to be empty, adding to the tranquil atmosphere. The lighting intensity of the lamps shows subtle fluctuations, suggesting either a slight adjustment in the camera's exposure or a natural fluctuation in the light source. The overall ambiance remains calm and peaceful throughout the sequence.

caption: The video depicts a row of lantern-style street lamps mounted along a building facade at dusk, viewed from a fixed angle. The nearest lamp dominates the left-center, while progressively smaller lanterns recede toward the right, with a dark teal evening sky filling the far edge. The lamps' warm glow pulses continuously throughout the excerpt, its halo expanding and softening before contracting and sharpening again. During peak bloom, the nearest lantern's internal panes and flame shape wash out into a bright diffuse orb. In the dimmer phases, the glass panes and inner core become crisp and defined once more. The mid-distance and far lamps brighten and dim in roughly the same rhythm, so the whole row appears to breathe together. The architecture, windows, and lamp positions remain unchanged, the visible change residing only in light intensity and bloom.
